title.text: Advance Your Career with AFP Membership

hero.text: Practitioner-driven. Peer-informed. Grounded in real-world experience. AFP connects you with treasury and finance professionals, practical tools and learning to grow your expertise and move your career forward.

cards.heading: AFP Power Hour
cards.text: Meet the AFP team, see what membership includes and get your questions answered live before you decide to join.

cards.heading: Earn the CTP® or FPAC®
cards.text: Progress your career and validate your experience with the globally recognized CTP and FPAC® certifications.

cards.heading: AFP Events
cards.text: Join 7,000+ treasury and finance professionals at AFP 2026, the premier global event for treasury and finance, plus year-round events and meet-ups.

headline.text: Stand Out with the CTP® or FPAC®

hero.text: Practitioner-driven. Peer-informed. Grounded in real-world experience. AFP connects corporate finance professionals to each other—and to ideas and solutions that translate into real impact.

cards.heading: AFP Power Hour
cards.text: Join this virtual open house where you can meet the team, explore resources, ask questions and learn all the ways that AFP can support your success.

cards.heading: Stablecoins & On-Chain Liquidity Certificate
cards.text: Designed for today’s corporate treasurer, this certificate helps professionals build practical knowledge of stablecoins and their growing role in finance. The program covers foundational concepts, treasury use cases, risk and governance considerations and operational implications for finance teams.

cards.heading: AFP Events
cards.text: Elevate your expertise through practitioner-led sessions, learn from finance industry peers, share real challenges, and build lasting relationships at the premier 2026 networking events for financial professionals.
